headline: 11-party alliance launches Dhaka-Chittagong long march for 6-point demand
summary: The Jamaat-led alliance began their journey on Saturday, though toll data suggests fewer vehicles participated than initially planned.
details: An 11-party opposition alliance, led by Jamaat-e-Islami, launched a long march from Dhaka to Chittagong on Saturday to demand the implementation of a referendum result and other 6-point demands.
caption:
From Dhaka to Chittagong: An 11-party alliance begins a massive long march for their 6-point demands.

An 11-party opposition alliance, led by Jamaat-e-Islami, launched a long march from Dhaka to Chittagong on Saturday to demand the implementation of a referendum result and other 6-point demands.

headline_marked: 3 arrested after [[body found on Elevated Expressway]]
headline: 3 arrested after body found on Elevated Expressway
summary: The victim, Ismail Hossain, was allegedly strangled and killed for 5 lakh BDT he had from selling land for his daughter's wedding.
details: Law enforcement agencies have arrested three suspects in connection with the recovery of a body from the Banani section of the Dhaka Elevated Expressway.
The victim has been identified as Ismail Hossain, a man from Gazipur. He was traveling from Jamalpur to Gazipur with 5 lakh BDT obtained from selling land to fund his daughter's wedding.
According to RAB-1, the suspects allegedly strangled Ismail to death and dumped his body on the expressway. The body was found with scotch tape wrapped around it.
The arrested individuals include the bus driver, Sohel Rana (40), supervisor Saju (28), and helper Monir (18). A 'Raj Classic' bus operating on the Dhaka-Jamalpur route was also seized.
The suspects were apprehended during a joint operation by Banani police and RAB in the Mohakhali area. The driver was arrested in front of the Covid Dedicated Hospital.
The suspects have been handed over to Banani Police Station. The DMP Media Center will hold a press conference on Sunday to provide further details about the investigation.
caption:
A man traveling with 5 lakh BDT for his daughter's wedding was strangled and dumped on the Dhaka Elevated Expressway.

Law enforcement agencies have arrested three suspects in connection with the recovery of a body from the Banani section of the Dhaka Elevated Expressway.

The victim has been identified as Ismail Hossain, a man from Gazipur. He was traveling from Jamalpur to Gazipur with 5 lakh BDT obtained from selling land to fund his daughter's wedding.

According to RAB-1, the suspects allegedly strangled Ismail to death and dumped his body on the expressway. The body was found with scotch tape wrapped around it.

The arrested individuals include the bus driver, Sohel Rana (40), supervisor Saju (28), and helper Monir (18). A 'Raj Classic' bus operating on the Dhaka-Jamalpur route was also seized.

The suspects were apprehended during a joint operation by Banani police and RAB in the Mohakhali area. The driver was arrested in front of the Covid Dedicated Hospital.

The suspects have been handed over to Banani Police Station. The DMP Media Center will hold a press conference on Sunday to provide further details about the investigation.

#Dhaka #CrimeNews #Bangladesh #ElevatedExpressway #Justice

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune
